subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Test Series subject · FMGE Test Series subject Year 2024 · Biochemistry Test

questions.stem: An elderly patient on a vegetarian diet presenting with easy fatigability and pallor was investigated. Peripheral smear showed findings of macrocytic anemia. Investigations reveal elevated serum homocysteine levels and normal serum methylmalonic acid levels. What is the probable cause of anemia in this patient?
